shots.visual: Caption: years ago. The thin bruised teenage boy, penniless and soaked, sits curled against the wall in the pouring rain, shivering.

sound.ambience: heavy rain pouring on the street, water dripping, distant city traffic

shots.visual: The teenage girl kneels under her yellow umbrella and holds out her lunch box to him, smiling kindly. Only the girl speaks.

sound.ambience: heavy rain pouring on the street, water dripping, distant city traffic

dialogue.speaker: Young Chloe
dialogue.voice: bright, kind, gentle young teenage girl

shots.visual: The girl ties a thin red string around the boy's left wrist while he eats, looking into his eyes. Only the girl speaks.
shots.camera: Close-up on the wrist, then her face.

sound.ambience: heavy rain pouring on the street, water dripping, distant city traffic

dialogue.speaker: Young Chloe
dialogue.voice: bright, kind, gentle young teenage girl
dialogue.line: So you remember someone cares about you.

shots.visual: The boy looks at the red string, then up at her with wet eyes. Only the boy speaks; the girl listens silently.

sound.ambience: heavy rain pouring on the street, water dripping, distant city traffic

dialogue.speaker: Young Ethan
dialogue.line: One day I'll come back for you. I promise.

shots.visual: The same faded red string on a grown man's wrist. Ethan paces restlessly by the window at night.
shots.camera: Close on the wrist, tilt up to his face.

sound.ambience: quiet penthouse at night, a faint hum of the city far below

shots.visual: Mark walks in and hands Ethan a thin manila folder. Only Mark speaks.
shots.camera: Medium shot, slow push-in on Mark.

sound.ambience: quiet penthouse at night, a faint hum of the city far below

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.voice: crisp, efficient, respectful man in his thirties
dialogue.line: Sir, we found her. After you were forced to leave the country, her family went under.

shots.visual: Mark continues, grave. Ethan opens the folder in silence. Only Mark speaks.

sound.ambience: quiet penthouse at night, a faint hum of the city far below

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.voice: crisp, efficient, respectful man in his thirties
dialogue.line: She's been working herself to the bone to afford her brother's treatment.

shots.visual: Ethan clenches his fists until his knuckles turn white, jaw tight, silent.

sound.ambience: quiet penthouse at night, a faint hum of the city far below
effects: leather creaking as his fist tightens

shots.visual: A dark, protective smile crosses Ethan's face. Only Ethan speaks.

sound.ambience: quiet penthouse at night, a faint hum of the city far below

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.voice: deep, quiet, controlled young man in his late twenties, ice cold to enemies, very soft and gentle with Chloe
dialogue.line: Do not reveal my true identity to her yet, Mark.

shots.visual: Ethan gives the order, eyes cold and certain. Only Ethan speaks.

sound.ambience: quiet penthouse at night, a faint hum of the city far below

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.voice: deep, quiet, controlled young man in his late twenties, ice cold to enemies, very soft and gentle with Chloe
dialogue.line: Appoint her as my personal assistant tomorrow morning.

shots.visual: Ethan turns to the window, his reflection cold in the glass. Only Ethan speaks.

sound.ambience: quiet penthouse at night, a faint hum of the city far below

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.voice: deep, quiet, controlled young man in his late twenties, ice cold to enemies, very soft and gentle with Chloe
dialogue.line: Let's see how many people in this company have been stepping on her.

shots.visual: Vivian listens to someone on the phone, sipping red wine; her sweet smile slowly turns cold. She does not speak.

sound.ambience: a quiet mansion at night, a clock ticking softly
